signal: Lambda raised a $1.5B Series E, signed a multibillion-dollar Microsoft deal, and is positioning for an IPO in 2026

email.body1:
Thomas, saw Lambda closed its $1.5B Series E and signed a multibillion-dollar Microsoft deal ahead of a potential IPO.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Thomas, quick follow-up for Lambda.

With an IPO in view, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most enterprise teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lambda needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Thomas, last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lambda's reply rate likely compares to peer AI-infra teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Thomas, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know the run into an IPO is its own kind of busy, and not every initiative makes the cut.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Lambda either way.
